Select distinct molecule ChEMBL identifier, compound name, and canonical SMILES for all molecules with structures reported in document CHEMBL3833083. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records on molregno, then to docs on doc_id filtering by chembl_id CHEMBL3833083. Inner join compound_structures on molregno to require canonical SMILES. Return chembl_id, compound_name, and canonical_smiles. Sort by chembl_id, compound_name, and canonical_smiles.
